results.title: Three AAP leaders join BJP ahead of Punjab Assembly election
results.content: Amritsar North MLA Kunwar Vijay Pratap, Sanour MLA Harmeet Singh Pathanmajra and Samana MLA Chetan Singh Jauramajra join the BJP in Delhi; State BJP president Kewal Singh Dhillon says it indicates the impending end of the party’s regime in Punjab

results.title: Asian Champions Trophy: India ends league phase with a thumping win over Korea
results.content: The two teams will meet again in Wednesday’s semifinal while Japan takes on Malaysia in the other last-four clash

results.title: In first high-level visit after new government’s arrival, Foreign Secretary Misri to visit Nepal on November 4-5
results.content: Misri’s visit to include discussions on Prime Minister Balendra Shah’s visit to India; appointment of Nepal’s new Ambassador to India and disaster assistance following the flash floods are also expected to be on the agenda

results.title: Doval meets Vietnam Defence Minister, agrees to deepen bilateral defence cooperation
results.content: The meeting was part of Mr. Doval’s two-day official visit to Vietnam; it follows the fourth India-Vietnam Security Dialogue held in October

results.title: Delhi Police register FIR against 22 protesters detained during rally towards Jantar Mantar
Rahul, Tejashwi are disrespecting the people’s mandate: BJP chief Nitin Nabin
results.content: Mr. Nabin accuses the Opposition of engaging in the politics of falsehood at INDIA bloc rally; accuses Mr. Gandhi of working for a “foreign toolkit”; says India will not be governed by the laws of the “Nehru-Gandhi” family

results.title: Cyclone Murasu nears A.P. coast, heavy rain alert issued
results.content: The India Meteorological Department (IMD) said the storm is likely to move with a “wind speed of 100 to 110 kmph (and) gusting up to 120 kmph between Nellore and Narasapur”.

results.title: Clean energy investments helped India soften West Asia crisis impact: PM Modi
results.content: Inaugurating Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo, Narendra Modi says India’s economy continued to grow despite the crisis; warns that excess dependence on fossil fuels could risk increased exposure to global disruptions
